title: HSK 2.14 · 院子, 住院, 出租, 碰到
focus: 租 · 草 · 院 · 送给 · 碰 · 碰到 · 以外 · 等于 · 例如 · 等到 · 住院 · 椅子 · 拿到 · 平等 · 例子 · 常见 · 得出 · 出租 · 院长 · 找出 · 院子 · 瓶子 · 出国 · 住房 · 出院 · 外地 · 送到 · 草地 · 回国 · 班长 · 句子 · 筷子 · 组长 · 个子 · 地铁站 · 站住 · 饺子 · 碰见 · 拿出
body:
Lots of 子 nouns (椅子, 筷子, 饺子), the 院 family (住院, 出院, 院长, 院子), and verbs with result endings 到 and 出 (拿到, 碰到, 找出, 拿出).

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 子 | zi | noun suffix (toneless) | 椅子, 例子, 院子, 瓶子, 句子, 筷子, 个子, 饺子 |
| 院 | yuàn | courtyard; institution, hospital (阝 + 完 wán) | 院, 住院, 院长, 院子, 出院 |
| 出 | chū | out | 得出, 出租, 找出, 出国, 出院, 拿出 |
| 到 | dào | arrive; result: reached, got | 碰到, 等到, 拿到, 送到 |
| 长 | zhǎng | head, chief (not cháng long) | 院长, 班长, 组长 |
| 等 | děng | to wait; equal | 等于, 等到, 平等 |
| 碰 | pèng | to bump into (石 stone + 并 bìng) | 碰, 碰到, 碰见 |
| 例 | lì | example (亻 + 列 liè) | 例如, 例子 |

## Watch out

- 长 is zhǎng (chief) in 院长, 班长, 组长, but cháng (long) in 长城.
- 住 zhù (live) vs 往 wǎng (toward): 住 has 亻 person, 往 has 彳 step.

cards.Example: 我想租个房子。 wǒ xiǎng zū ge fángzi: I want to rent a place.
cards.Notes: 禾 grain + 且 qiě (phonetic): rent was once paid in grain

cards.Example: 别在草上走。 bié zài cǎo shang zǒu: Don't walk on the grass.
cards.Notes: 艹 plant + 早 zǎo (phonetic)

cards.Example: 孩子们在院里玩。 háizimen zài yuàn li wánr: The kids are playing in the yard.
cards.Notes: 阝 + 完 wán (phonetic); 医院 hospital, 学院 college

cards.Example: 这本书送给你。 zhè běn shū sònggěi nǐ: This book is for you.
cards.Notes: 送 send + 给 give

cards.Example: 别碰我的东西。 bié pèng wǒ de dōngxi: Don't touch my stuff.
cards.Notes: 石 stone + 并 bìng (phonetic): stones knocking

cards.Meaning: to run into; to come across
cards.Example: 我在路上碰到了老师。 wǒ zài lù shang pèngdào le lǎoshī: I ran into my teacher on the way.
cards.Notes: 碰 bump + 到 reach = bump into

cards.Example: 除了他以外都来了。 chúle tā yǐwài dōu lái le: Everyone came except him.
cards.Notes: 以 by + 外 outside = outside of

cards.Example: 一加一等于二。 yī jiā yī děngyú èr: One plus one equals two.
cards.Notes: 等 equal + 于 to

cards.Example: 我爱吃水果，例如苹果。 wǒ ài chī shuǐguǒ, lìrú píngguǒ: I love fruit, like apples.
cards.Notes: 例 example + 如 like

cards.Meaning: to wait until; by the time
cards.Example: 等到明天再说吧。 děngdào míngtiān zài shuō ba: Let's wait until tomorrow.
cards.Notes: 等 wait + 到 until

cards.Example: 奶奶住院了。 nǎinai zhùyuàn le: Grandma is in the hospital.
cards.Notes: 住 stay + 院 (医院) hospital

cards.Example: 这把椅子很舒服。 zhè bǎ yǐzi hěn shūfu: This chair is comfortable.
cards.Notes: 椅 = 木 wood + 奇 qí (phonetic) + 子 noun suffix

cards.Example: 我拿到票了。 wǒ nádào piào le: I got the tickets.
cards.Notes: 拿 hold (合 + 手 hand) + 到 reached = got it in hand

cards.Example: 男女平等。 nán nǚ píngděng: Men and women are equal.
cards.Notes: 平 level + 等 rank = same level

cards.Example: 你能举个例子吗？ nǐ néng jǔ ge lìzi ma: Can you give an example?
cards.Notes: 例 example + 子 noun suffix

cards.Example: 这个问题很常见。 zhège wèntí hěn chángjiàn: This problem is very common.
cards.Notes: 常 often + 见 see = often seen

cards.Example: 我们得出了答案。 wǒmen déchū le dá'àn: We came up with the answer.
cards.Notes: 得 get + 出 out = get out of it

cards.Example: 这个房子出租吗？ zhège fángzi chūzū ma: Is this house for rent?
cards.Notes: 出 out + 租 rent; 出租车 taxi

cards.Example: 他是医院的院长。 tā shì yīyuàn de yuànzhǎng: He's the head of the hospital.
cards.Notes: 院 institution + 长 zhǎng chief

cards.Example: 我找出了问题。 wǒ zhǎochū le wèntí: I found the problem.
cards.Notes: 找 look for + 出 out

cards.Example: 院子里有一棵树。 yuànzi li yǒu yì kē shù: There's a tree in the yard.
cards.Notes: 院 courtyard + 子 noun suffix

cards.Example: 瓶子里没水了。 píngzi li méi shuǐ le: The bottle is empty.
cards.Notes: 瓶 bottle (并 + 瓦 pottery) + 子 noun suffix

cards.Example: 她明年要出国。 tā míngnián yào chūguó: She's going abroad next year.
cards.Notes: 出 out + 国 country

cards.Example: 这里住房很贵。 zhèlǐ zhùfáng hěn guì: Housing here is expensive.
cards.Notes: 住 live + 房 house

cards.Example: 他明天出院。 tā míngtiān chūyuàn: He gets out of the hospital tomorrow.
cards.Notes: 出 out + 院 hospital; mirror of 住院

cards.Meaning: out of town, elsewhere in the country
cards.Example: 我是外地人。 wǒ shì wàidì rén: I'm not from around here.
cards.Notes: 外 outside + 地 place

cards.Meaning: to deliver to; to see (someone) to
cards.Example: 我把你送到家。 wǒ bǎ nǐ sòngdào jiā: I'll get you home.
cards.Notes: 送 send + 到 arrive

cards.Example: 我们坐在草地上。 wǒmen zuò zài cǎodì shang: We sat on the grass.
cards.Notes: 草 grass + 地 ground

cards.Example: 他下个月回国。 tā xià ge yuè huíguó: He's going home next month.
cards.Notes: 回 return + 国 country

cards.Example: 她是我们的班长。 tā shì wǒmen de bānzhǎng: She's our class monitor.
cards.Notes: 班 class + 长 zhǎng chief

cards.Example: 这个句子很长。 zhège jùzi hěn cháng: This sentence is long.
cards.Notes: 句 sentence (勹 + 口) + 子 noun suffix

cards.Example: 你会用筷子吗？ nǐ huì yòng kuàizi ma: Can you use chopsticks?
cards.Notes: 筷 = ⺮ bamboo + 快 kuài (phonetic)

cards.Example: 谁是组长？ shéi shì zǔzhǎng: Who's the group leader?
cards.Notes: 组 group + 长 zhǎng chief

cards.Example: 他个子很高。 tā gèzi hěn gāo: He's tall.
cards.Notes: 个 (measure word) + 子 noun suffix

cards.Example: 地铁站离这儿很近。 dìtiězhàn lí zhèr hěn jìn: The subway station is close.
cards.Notes: 地 ground + 铁 iron (rail) + 站 station

cards.Example: 站住！别跑！ zhànzhù, bié pǎo: Stop! Don't run!
cards.Notes: 站 stand + 住 firmly in place

cards.Example: 我们包饺子吧。 wǒmen bāo jiǎozi ba: Let's make dumplings.
cards.Notes: 饺 = 饣 food + 交 jiāo (phonetic)

cards.Example: 我碰见了一个老朋友。 wǒ pèngjiàn le yí ge lǎo péngyou: I ran into an old friend.
cards.Notes: 碰 bump + 见 see

cards.Example: 他拿出了手机。 tā náchū le shǒujī: He took out his phone.
cards.Notes: 拿 hold + 出 out
